reason: TrainerOutput.training_loss was rank-local because the harness intentionally returned unprepared rank-local DataLoaders. The base result showed distinct per-rank TrainerOutput values even for equal-token control, so it cannot support a cross-rank scalar loss comparison.
decision: Do not treat v3 as a pass or fail for the global loss gate. Do not run its candidate arm. V4 defines a global metric and uses a fresh fixture.
